answer_1.quote: 3MDBench simulates realistic medical consultations via multi-turn dialogues between an evaluated Doctor Agent and a Patient Agent
datasets: 3MDBench (built from Kaggle, ISIC Archive, Google SCIN, Fitzpatrick17k, Bing Image Search)
answer_1.outputs: Generated medical dialogues and symptom descriptions

answer_2.quote: Factuality measures how often utterances reference prompted symptoms, computed via NV-Embed-v2 embeddings with a cosine similarity threshold of 0.8

answer_3.quote: To assess the clinical competence, we adapted our evaluation criteria from the Mini-Clinical Evaluation Exercise (Mini-CEX), a standard in medical education, where patients evaluate medical consultations via structured questions.
methods: Assessor Agent evaluation (using prompt from Appendix H.4)

answer_4.quote: Five human annotators rated dialogues and extracted diagnoses using the exact instructions as the Assessor Agent (Appendix H.4).
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators used the same instructions as the Assessor Agent (Appendix H.4) to evaluate dialogues on diagnostic accuracy and communication quality.
